negative_findings.description: No official Czech dataset enumerates ATMs operated by independent deployers (IADs). ČNB's payment-statistics commentary explicitly states its ATM figures exclude entities without payment-service authorisation, since operating an ATM is not itself a payment service.
negative_findings.result_summary: IAD estate size (Euronet ~600-700 units per media reporting) exists only in company communications and press, never in official statistics.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any CZ ATM-count series taken from ČNB systematically understates the true estate and misstates the cash-access trend.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Czech for named second-tier independent ATM deployers beyond Euronet (e.g. Cardpay-type operators); no confirmed active Czech IAD brand other than Euronet surfaced in these searches.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only Euronet was confirmed as an independent, non-bank ATM deployer with a public Czech presence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cell rationale assumes a plural IAD landscape; on current evidence CZ may be effectively single-IAD, which changes the market-structure conclusion.

negative_findings.description: No Czech trade association for CIT / cash-handling companies (an equivalent of ESTA at EU level) was identified in Czech-language searching during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: CIT actor mapping must be assembled from the ČNB processors register plus individual company filings, not from an association.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Removes the cheapest aggregate source; collection cost for CIT market sizing is correspondingly higher.

negative_findings.description: Financial statements for Loomis Czech Republic a.s., Brink's Cash Solutions (CZ) and G4S Secure Solutions (CZ) exist in Sbírka listin but were not retrieved in this pass; access requires form-driven register queries and the PDFs are frequently scanned images.
negative_findings.result_summary: Filings confirmed to exist by third-party register mirrors; contents unverified here.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The only audited CIT revenue figures require an OCR-capable collection step, not a plain HTTP fetch.

brief: The Czech cash ecosystem splits cleanly into three source layers. Official statistics (ČNB circulation data, payment-system commentary, and the Act 136/2011 register of licensed banknote processors) are authoritative and machine-collectable but deliberately exclude independent ATM deployers, leaving a structural blind spot on the non-bank ATM estate. That gap is filled only by commercial disclosure — Euronet's Czech fee/network pages and its parent's SEC filings, plus Sbírka listin accounts for Loomis, Brink's and G4S — and by the industry association SBK, which remains the sole public quantifier of cash-back at POS. The third layer is politics and media: the recurring constitutional right-to-cash bills, iROZHLAS/Peníze.cz branch-and-cash-desk trackers, and Česká pošta's card-withdrawal rollout are where municipality-level cash-access evidence actually gets published. Priority next steps are enumerating the full processor register and hunting a municipality-level ATM/branch accessibility dataset.
